qa.title: Q1250 (Jun. 13, 2025)
qa.question: I have this follower on my field, and my opponent plays Sylvia, the Condemner, selecting this follower with its Fanfare ability. Can I still engage this follower to deal 6 damage to Sylvia, the Condemner?
qa.answer:
No. When Sylvia, the Condemner is put onto the field, its Fanfare and this follower's automatic ability will trigger simultaneously, and both abilities will become pending.

When both players control pending abilities, the active player resolves theirs first. In this case, your opponent is the active player, so they resolve Sylvia, the Condemner's Fanfare, destroying this follower.

Next, you would resolve this follower's automatic ability, but since it is now in the cemetery, you would be unable to pay the engage cost, and thus cannot deal the 6 damage to Sylvia, the Condemner.

qa.title: Q1309 (Jun. 13, 2025)
qa.question: I have this follower on my field, and my opponent has an evolved Ginsetsu, Great Fox and a One-Tailed Fox. Since Ginsetsu, Great Fox's ability increases Yokai followers' damage dealt by 1, how much damage would my leader take if my opponent attacked me with a 1-attack One-Tailed Fox?
qa.answer:
Your leader would take either 0 damage or 1 damage, depending on your decision. When there are multiple abilities modifying damage dealt, the player receiving the damage decides the order the abilities are applied. In this case, depending on the order, the final damage taken can be calculated either of the following 2 ways:

1. Your leader takes 1 damage because you decide to apply Ginsetsu, Great Fox's ability to increase the damage dealt by 1 first, so the One-Tailed Fox will deal 2 damage before this follower's ability reduces the damage dealt by 1.

2. Your leader takes 0 damage because you decide to apply this follower's ability to reduce damage dealt by 1 first, so the One-Tailed Fox will deal 0 damage before Ginsetsu, Great Fox's ability increases the damage dealt by 1. However, Ginsetsu, Great Fox's ability only takes effect when damage is dealt, and 0 damage doesn't count as dealing damage. Thus, the ability doesn't take effect and the damage taken by your leader remains at 0.
